title: Fraction calculator
summary: A struct for a fraction, functions that operate on structs, and a greatest common divisor to keep results reduced.
hints: `struct fraction { long num, den; };` and one function per operation that returns a `struct fraction`. A function `reduce` divides both fields by their `gcd` and moves the sign to the numerator.
Parse each line with `sscanf(line, "%ld/%ld %c %ld/%ld", ...)`: it returns 5 when the line has the right shape. For division, `a/b / c/d = (a*d)/(b*c)`: it fails when `c` is 0.
